description: Terraform or doctl a DOKS cluster; install Knative Serving (Kourier ingress) and the gVisor RuntimeClass. Deploy an image from EdgeContainerDockerfile (Laravel/FrankenPHP) as a Knative Service with containerConcurrency set per requestsPerInstance, scale-to-zero on, min-scale 0/1. Measure the cold-start wake time (p50/p95) and the cost of an idle cluster. Exit: a documented yes/no plus numbers in docs/EDGE_PLATFORM_STATUS.md.
title: Spike: DOKS cluster with Knative + gVisor, one generated image served with scale-to-zero
